Name: Comfort Air Conditioner
Author: HappyFamilyFarm
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Comfort Air Conditioner adds a wall-mounted air conditioner to Stardew Valley. It's a cozy, fully passive home appliance that brings you back to full health and energy the moment you step inside your farmhouse.

No buttons, no menus, no dialogue, no waiting in a hot spring. Just walk through your front door and let the cool air do its work. Your stamina and health refill to maximum within about a second, and the dreaded "Exhausted" debuff is wiped away instantly, so you can keep working, mining, and fishing without the frustration of a drained energy bar.

It's the perfect first purchase for new farmers: available on first days of Spring, before the bathhouse even opens, it turns your home into a true sanctuary — a free, unlimited, instant recovery station that works all year round.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. [b]Install SMAPI[/b] — download and install the latest version from [smapi.io](https://smapi.io). Follow its setup guide.
2. [b]Install Content Patcher[/b] — download it from its Nexus page and drop it into your `Mods` folder.
3. [b]Install this mod[/b] — extract the downloaded archive into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder. You should end up with these two folders inside `Mods`:
   - `[CP] Comfort Air Conditioner`
   - `Comfort Air Conditioner Mod`
4. [b]Launch the game[/b] — run Stardew Valley through SMAPI. On first load, the mod will report itself as installed in the SMAPI console.
5. [b]Buy and enjoy[/b] — visit Robin's Carpenter Shop on any day of Spring, buy the [b]Wall-mounted Air Conditioner[/b] for [b]1000g[/b], bring it home, and hang it on your wall. Done!

[b]Note:[/b] Make sure both the [b]SMAPI[/b]  and  [b]Content Patcher[/b]  mods are installed together. The mod won't work if either part is missing.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- [b]Wall-mounted furniture[/b] — a clean, modern, white split-unit air conditioner in authentic pixel art, sold at Robin's Carpenter Shop for [b]1000g[/b], available from day one.
- [b]Instant full recovery[/b] — stand anywhere inside your farmhouse and your energy and health snap back to maximum in about a second.
- [b]Exhaustion cleared[/b] — the blue "Exhausted" debuff (the crying-face icon that slows you down) is removed immediately, restoring your speed and tool swing rate.
- [b]Zero interaction, zero noise[/b] — completely passive. No buttons, no menus, no dialogue, and absolutely no sound effects. You'll only see your health and stamina bars become full instantly.
- [b]Optional on/off switch[/b] — right-click the air conditioner to turn it off (the animation and recovery pause) or back on. Each unit remembers its own setting.
- [b]Quiet breathing animation[/b] — a gentle 2-frame animation where the air vent flaps open and closed while a few colored lights show the unit regulating temperature.
- [b]Works in Spring[/b] — while the bathhouse stays locked until Summer 3rd, your air conditioner gives you free, unlimited recovery whenever you hang it up in Spring.
- [b]Light on performance[/b] — the mod checks once per second with negligible cost; you won't notice any impact on your game.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Stardew Valley 1.6 (PC)
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer
- Content Patcher 2.0.0 or newer
- (Optional) SpaceCore — only needed to display the custom item description in the shop tooltip; the mod works fine without it.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Thanks to [b]Eric Barone[/b] for Stardew Valley, the game we all love.
- Thanks to [b]Pathoschild[/b] for SMAPI and Content Patcher, which make modding this game a joy.
- Thanks to my Pappa and Mama for their encouragement since I am a 10-year-old boy. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for endless inspiration, tutorials, and pixel art reference.[/color]
